title: T1.1: domain.rs — StoryTypeSet event, TypeDef, snapshot field, fold logic

text:
Requirements: R1, R2, R3, R4, R6, R28, R34. Files: src/domain.rs.
AC: StoryEvent has StoryTypeSet { at, story_type } variant; TypeDef struct with slug + description; StorySnapshot.story_type: Option<String> with serde(default); ImportStory.story_type: Option<String> with serde(default); ProgressRollup struct with children_done + children_total; fold_story handles StoryTypeSet; last_activity_type returns "type-set"; existing domain::tests pass; new fold tests for story_type.
